source.title: 8分钟搞懂“编程的鬼打墙”——递归
source.author: 林粒粒呀

scope.zh-CN: 4张关键代码/公式帧，加取得阶段首尾检查；原生语音时序核对。抽样复核，未逐帧审看、未编译运行。
scope.en: Four critical code/formula frames plus acquisition head/tail checks; native speech timing verified. Sampled review, not every-frame inspection or code execution.

observation.zh-CN: 通用阶乘关系式可见；这是全局抽帧位置，不是语音原生时间。
observation.en: The general factorial relation is visible; this is a global frame position, not a native speech timestamp.
The teaching slide uses n == 0 as its base case.

observation.zh-CN: 完整演示改用 n <= 0；不能据此宣称作品定义了负数阶乘。
observation.en: The complete demonstration uses n <= 0; this does not establish a definition of negative factorials.

observation.zh-CN: 画面返回链最终显示120；本次没有运行代码。
observation.en: The displayed return chain reaches 120; code was not executed in this review.

observation.zh-CN: 该语音段解释阶乘的递推关系；时间来自服务器字段，未由画面位置倒推。
observation.en: This speech segment explains the factorial recurrence; timing comes from server fields, not subtraction from a frame position.

publication.zh-CN: 经宿主修订的公共摘要；不含原媒体、完整转写或完整代码。
publication.en: Public summary of the host-corrected result; no original media, full transcript or full code.

summary.zh-CN: 通过自调用、终止条件和阶乘调用/返回链解释递归。报告区分教学画面、语音依据与静态边界推断。
summary.en: Explains recursion through self-calls, a reachable base case and factorial call/return chains. The result separates teaching visuals, speech evidence and static boundary inferences.

corrections.zh-CN: 移除把全局抽帧时间减去300秒后冒充ASR原生时间的表述；画面与语音时间分别核对。
corrections.en: Removed claims that subtracting 300 seconds from a global frame time produced native ASR timing; frame and speech clocks were checked separately.

corrections.zh-CN: 时间线按真实证据范围修订，教学搜索页面不宣称为实时网页。
corrections.en: Timeline ranges were corrected to actual evidence, and a teaching search-page visual was not claimed to be a live website.

zh-CN: 本机实测，不代表异机或所有作品可用。
模型原始输出可能有错，公共摘要以宿主修订后的报告和复核记录为准。
实际提交量是本次记录，不是固定成本、速度或平台结算承诺。
媒体已清理；哈希用于来源追溯，不提供失效本地媒体链接。
en: Local evidence does not establish other-device or universal-work support.
Original model output may be wrong; this summary follows the host-corrected report and review.
Submitted quantities describe this run, not fixed cost, speed or settled billing.
Media were removed; hashes support traceability without broken local-media links.
